scope: Fresh visual review of all 40 lessons in assignment-3. I read every full lesson script, viewed each scene overview and motion overview, inspected at least one native encoded 1920x1080 frame per lesson, and viewed an all-scenes motion atlas for every lesson. Each atlas shows early, middle, and late decoded frames from a selected highest-motion beat in every scene. Focused scene sheets were used for unclear motion or technical details. Scores assess composition, readability, mathematical and layout correctness, plus causal motion and narration alignment. Readiness requires both scores at least 90 and no unresolved medium or high finding. These samples do not establish continuous playback, full-audio listening, or inspection of every encoded frame. The conformal narration source was corrected after its reviewed MP4 was rendered; that lesson remains blocked until the output is regenerated and checked.
